Description

Own shared frontend infrastructure for a design-system-heavy B2B platform. The role needs senior React judgement, accessibility fluency, and a habit of shipping reusable UI primitives.

React, TypeScript, Next.js, component APIs, performance profiling, and evidence of mentoring product engineers.

Responsibilities

Lead component architecture, partner with design, improve accessibility baselines, and unblock teams building enterprise workflows.

AI ✦ rubric
